subtopics.title: The Cost Table and the Three Cost Concepts

questions.question: Total cost at zero output is R20. What does this R20 represent?
options: Fixed cost — paid whether or not anything is produced
Marginal cost of the first unit

questions.question: Total cost is R60 at 3 units and R76 at 4 units. The marginal cost of the fourth unit is:
Average cost at 4 units (total cost R76) is:
Why does average cost FALL over the first few units of output?
options: Because the fixed cost is spread over more units
Because marginal cost is always rising

subtopics.title: Building the Revenue Side at a Market Price of R30

questions.question: At a market price of R30, total revenue at 5 units is:
For a price-taking firm, average revenue always equals:
Why is marginal revenue constant at R30 for this firm?
options: Because each extra unit sells at the unchanged market price of R30
Because output never exceeds six units

questions.question: Using total revenue minus total cost, profit at 5 units is:
The economist's rule for the profit-maximising output is to produce:
options: Until total cost equals total revenue
Until marginal revenue equals marginal cost, stopping before MC exceeds MR
As many units as capacity allows
Where average cost is at its minimum

questions.question: The sixth unit has marginal cost R38 against marginal revenue R30. Producing it would:
The firm still makes R40 profit at six units. Why is six NOT the right output?
options: Because profit at five units (R48) is higher — the sixth unit itself destroys profit
Because the firm cannot sell six units
Because fixed costs rise at six units

subtopics.title: Verifying, Graphing and the Habits That Earn Marks

questions.question: How do you verify the profit-maximising output 'from both sides'?
options: Check the last produced unit adds profit (MC below MR) and the next unit would subtract profit (MC above MR)
Compare total cost at zero and six units
Draw the demand curve for the industry

questions.question: On the graph, the profit-maximising output is found where:
options: The marginal cost curve crosses the flat marginal revenue line from below

questions.question: Which pair of verbs matches the two derived measures?
options: Average: divide; Marginal: subtract neighbouring totals
